testInstructions: Launch <PowerToysCheckout>\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe. Open Advanced Paste settings, confirm Paste as single line appears among core actions, optionally assign its shortcut, then copy multi-line text and invoke Advanced Paste or the shortcut. Verify line breaks and adjacent horizontal whitespace become single spaces, inline tabs and Unicode remain intact, leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed, and the shortcut appears in dashboard/OOBE and conflict detection.
